label: Decorative concrete · board-formed (light grey, vertical form lines + tie recesses)

source.selection_reason: Owner-curated board-formed concrete — clean, bright, even, face-on, with crisp vertical form-board lines, tie-bolt recesses and fine pitting. The flatter/cleaner of the two board-formed candidates (the brief's tie-break) at high resolution (4898x3674).
source.crop_reason: 3500px square from the centre, capturing several full form-board widths and tie recesses with the most even lighting; trims the extreme edges.
source.rejected_set: lined-concrete-texture = darker, higher-contrast, more uneven board-to-board tone (more grunge but harder to de-light evenly). EXCLUDED per brief: kitchen-with-sink scene, plasterer-renovating-walls, brick-wall, full-frame-shot-wall (wall not floor), and the .mov video.

material_truth.fillers: None as aggregate — this is a board-formed cast concrete surface. Texture = vertical timber-form-board imprint (grain + plank seams), circular form-tie recesses, and fine bug-hole pitting.
material_truth.finish: As-cast / lightly sealed, matte. Real surface relief from board seams and tie recesses.
material_truth.manufacturer_recipe: Architectural board-formed concrete (timber-board formwork imprint) or a decorative-concrete overlay stamped/textured to a board-formed pattern; matte penetrating sealer. For a floor application this is typically a polished or sealed decorative topping carrying the board-formed look.

colour.note: Moderate variance (stdev ~19) from the form lines + pitting. Matrix hex ≈ overall mean — light neutral grey, very slightly warm.

scale.physical_mm_per_tile: ~500-600 mm represented by the 2048px master (form boards read ~90-110 mm wide; the crop spans roughly 5-6 boards).
scale.tile_note: Manifest 'tile' is an integer repeat. 2 keeps the form boards at a realistic ~90-110 mm read on a ~600-900 mm plate and the vertical lines wrap cleanly. 2-3 is the usable band; 1 makes the boards look oversized.

gloss.note: Matte as-cast concrete. roughness.png mean 0.764 (chipsSmooth=false → high uniform roughness). 0.72-0.80 reads as matte concrete; lower toward 0.5 for a sealed/polished decorative-concrete floor.

normal.png.strength: gen-pbr bump 5.5 (board seams + tie recesses + pitting); R range 0-254

processing.decode: sharp JPG -> extract 3500px square -> lanczos3 DOWNSCALE to 2048 (sharp, no upscaling).
processing.delight: sharp divide-by-heavy-blur (sigma scaled to ~128px) re-multiplied by per-channel means -> flattened the gentle left-right lighting falloff, lighting-neutral albedo.
processing.seamless: Half-offset (quadrant-swap) wrap + feathered cross-fade heal blending with a 180°-rotated copy of the offset. Vertical form lines wrap naturally; the horizontal heal band is barely perceptible against the pitting. Validated by 2x2 tiling.
processing.pbr: scripts/gen-pbr-maps.js decorative-concrete --root=3d-assets/textures-v4 (bump 5.5, baseRough 0.8, chipsSmooth false, ao 1.0).

caveats: Not upscaled — downscaled from a 3500px crop.
Board-formed concrete is directional (vertical lines): looks best when the plate UVs keep the lines vertical. Rotating 90° will make the seams read horizontal.
Faint residual horizontal band at the seam-heal line under raking light; invisible at render scale on a matte surface.

This is a board-formed WALL-style imprint applied as a floor texture (the source is a clean architectural-concrete surface). If a troweled/polished decorative-concrete floor without the plank pattern is preferred, that is closer to the microtopping master.

recommended_manifest.palette_note: matrix light-grey, overall mean, light board, mid-grey seam, dark recess/pit
recommended_manifest.note: Repoint pbr.* to textures-v4/decorative-concrete/* to use this new set. (Orchestrator applies — do not edit manifest here.)
